Port of Palompon. The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of
Palompon situated in the Municipality of Palompon, Province of Leyte, is hereby
delineated and established, particularly described as follows:
Beginning at a point marked 1 on the plan, being N. 00 deg. 24' E., 302.29 m.
from BLLM No. 1, Palompon Cadastre, thence:

PPA Jurisdiction. The Palompon Port zone, as delineated, is
hereby placed under the administrative jurisdiction of the PPA, which shall, consistent
with the regional industrial plans of the government, implement a program for the proper
zoning, planning, development and utilization of the port.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended
or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is declared
invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid
and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 5th day of November
Lord, Two Thousand and Thirteen.
